age.Description: Age of the participant at time of testing

center.Description: Recording centre (source column); UPMC = University of Pittsburgh Medical Center

curator.Description: Data curator / principal investigator at the centre (source column)

UPDRS_total.Description: MDS-UPDRS part III total score, off medication, 1-3 months before surgery (paper methods)

UPDRS_left.Description: MDS-UPDRS part III left-body subscore (source column)

UPDRS_right.Description: MDS-UPDRS part III right-body subscore (source column)

implant_type.Description: Electrode types present in the subject-level electrodes.tsv (ECOG_* = subdural strip; STN_* = DBS lead, Medtronic 3389 per paper)

implanted_hemisphere.Description: Hemispheres with contacts in the subject-level electrodes files (from channel names _LEFT_/_RIGHT_)
